title: Find the names of all borderless cards illustrated by artists who have also
question: Find the names of all borderless cards illustrated by artists who have also designed cards in sets that are exclusively available in Japanese and not on Magic: The Gathering Online, provided these cards are ranked below 100 on EDHRec and have a 2015 frame style. Additionally, include only those cards that are banned in at least one play format.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_049
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'borderless'
  AND c.XCL_014 < 100
  AND c.XCL_019 = '2015'
  AND c.XCL_002 IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_002
    FROM cards AS c2
    INNER JOIN sets AS s2 ON c2.XCL_063 = s2.XCL_099
    INNER JOIN set_translations AS st ON s2.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
    WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
      AND s2.XCL_101 = 0
  )
  AND c.XCL_072 IN (
    SELECT l.XCL_086
    FROM legalities AS l
    WHERE l.XCL_085 = 'Banned'
  );
